newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower as investors book profit.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower as investors book profit.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended down amid a selling pressure by investors booking profit for a second straight session, brokers said.

"Most shares shed because sellers booked profit in a falling market. Buyers remained mostly timid today", said one broker. The Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index fell 13.52 points or 0.87 percent at 1,532.45 on a turnover of 122.6 million taka. Of 118 issues traded, 73 closed down, 37 ended up and eight unchanged.
Olympic Industries lost 34.54 taka to 1,183.98, Beximco Pharmaceuticals shed 5.01 to 135.76 and AMCL Pran gained 104.95 to 1,338.42. --Dhaka Newsroom 88-02-506363
